name: list_nodes
description: List nodes in a SageMaker HyperPod cluster. Read-only — no cost, no confirmation required. Returns each node's id, instance group, instance type, and status. Call this first when the user asks to audit a cluster, to check health, or to pick nodes for version_check.

cluster_name.description: Name of the HyperPod cluster. describe_cluster resolves it to an ARN + cluster id.

_user_id.description: Authenticated user id — always pass the value of the CURRENT_USER_ID env var.

name: check_versions
description: Audit installed software versions on HyperPod cluster nodes via SSM. Read-only. Pushes a bundled shell script through AWS-RunShellScript per node, rate-limited to 3 TPS, and returns a per-node map of category → version for the standard HPC stack: CUDA, cuDNN, NCCL, EFA, AWS OFI NCCL, GDRCopy, MPI, Neuron SDK, Python, PyTorch, container runtime. Non-interactive only (no TTY commands). 60 s per-node timeout.

instance_ids.description: Optional list of specific node ids to audit. Omit to audit every InService node returned by list_nodes. Use this to sample (e.g. first 3 nodes) on large clusters.

categories.description: Optional list of categories to collect. Omit to collect all. Narrow the scope on large clusters to stay under the 60 s per-node timeout.

_user_id.description: Authenticated user id — always pass the value of the CURRENT_USER_ID env var.
